text:
Samir: quick follow-up from the contract-migration RFC — I want to align on the adaptive proxy behaviour. two options: (A) rewrite missing/renamed fields in-proxy to keep callers alive, or (B) strict reject with 4xx and a clear migration error so clients have to upgrade. leaning toward hybrid but need thoughts.

Maria: hybrid makes sense in principle but we need a strict safety boundary. what fields are safe to rewrite vs which ones need explicit client changes? also: how do we keep visibility on rewrites? we should emit telemetry and link to a migration guide. :mag:

Devon: +1 on telemetry. my concern with rewriting is silent correctness issues. if a rewrite can change semantics (eg renamed enum values) we should fail. For trivial renames/aliases or added optional fields, proxy rewrite is OK. we should have an allowlist of transformations.

Priya: propose rollout plan: start with passive rewrites (log only), then opt-in rewrite via header for a subset of traffic, then enable for 1% -> 10% -> 100% per tenant. header idea: `X-Redwood-Compat: v2-to-v3=opt-in` so clients can opt themselves in during migration. sample config snippet in proxy: ```rules: - match: path_prefix: /v3 transformations: - rename: from: "old_field" to: "new_field" safe: true```

Samir: perf note — extra JSON transforms add CPU and allocs. we should limit rewrites to small payloads and cache transformation outcomes for repeated requests with identical schemas. also need to measure p50/p95 impact.

Devon: metrics we want: `shim.rewrites.count`, `shim.rejects.count`, `shim.rewrite.latency.p95`, plus correlation tags: tenant_id, model, route. create dashboards and alerts when rejects spike.

Maria: testing: we need unit tests for every transformation rule, plus a fuzz-run that feeds varied payloads to the proxy. e2e: run canary with a few internal tenants (dev + staging) and verify objective metrics (error rate, latency, correctness via golden responses). also make sure canary has a rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: canary deploy: adaptive-proxy v0.3 -> staging at 2026-03-19T15:04Z (sha: a1b2c3).

Priya: client education: docs + migration checklist + sample client lib that sets `X-Redwood-Compat`. Also add a graceful-exit header so clients can opt out of rewrites if they detect mismatch: `X-Redwood-Compat-Mode: warn|rewrite|reject`.

Samir: agreed. action items: (1) Devon to draft allowlist schema and telemetry plan, (2) Maria to own tests + fuzz harness, (3) Priya to author header and rollout playbook, (4) Samir to add perf gating and cache strategy. I'll open the follow-up issue and link the RFC. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
